answer: Bind each agent to a refundable stake that unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work over many epochs. A newcomer starts on bare tundra, near-zero weight, and standing accretes slowly like a coral reef built layer by layer. A clone fleet earns no history: each fake must sink its own collateral and wait its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly. No clever cipher of self-made claims buys the weight that only attested work can earn.
